# Gas Canisters
Gas canisters allow gas to be stored in a portable container for easy transport. They can hold [color=orange][protodata="StorageCanister" comp="GasCanister" member="Volume"/] liters[/color] of gas.
Portable tanks can be connected to a gas canister and refilled through the canister's output valve. The output valve also has an adjustable pressure regulator that controls the pressure of the connected portable tank.
Opening a canister's output valve without a portable tank connected will release gas into the atmosphere at the regulator's set pressure.
[bold]Always close the output valve before removing a portable tank![/bold]
## Connector Ports Gas canisters and [textlink="portable scrubbers" link="PortableScrubber"] can be connected to a [textlink="pipe network" link="PipeNetworks"] by wrenching the device over a connector port. Once connected, gas moves freely into and out of the canister, equalizing pressure, temperature, and composition.
A pump can be used to feed gas into the canister or draw gas out of it, which is useful for filling or emptying the canister completely.
